final: WITH cust_avg AS (SELECT i.CustomerId AS cid, c.Country AS country, AVG(i.Total) AS avg_total FROM Invoice i JOIN Customer c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId GROUP BY i.CustomerId, c.Country), country_avg AS (SELECT country, AVG(avg_total) AS cavg FROM cust_avg GROUP BY country), overall AS (SELECT AVG(cavg) AS ov FROM country_avg WHERE cavg IS NOT NULL) SELECT AVG(k.cavg) AS avg_country_avg, AVG(k.cavg - o.ov) AS avg_diff_from_overall FROM country_avg k JOIN overall o ON o.ov IS NOT NULL WHERE k.cavg IS NOT NULL AND k.cavg > o.ov
